attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Create one high-resolution portrait-card fusion using exactly two inputs. Image1 is the sole authority for clothing, pose, hair, expression, light, and crop. Image2 provides only the mascot identity and anatomy. Transform the human anatomy into a smooth golden-yellow compact near-round mascot head and body with green-ringed black eyes and a source-matching mouth. Preserve the actual short grey/brown side-parted hair with a brushed-up top, real dark/grey eyebrows, and the narrow dark upper-lip moustache. Maintain the serious closed mouth and smooth clean chin. Keep the olive/brown closed military tunic with a red upright collar, clearly visible gold star-shaped collar emblems, and red/gold shoulder edges. Do not invent hidden full medal rows or additional insignia. Ensure a clearly rounded short U-shaped lower yellow head that immediately meets the raised and broadened existing neckline. Use a very short broad neck transition with minimal throat exposure. Avoid any separate yellow neck shaft, pointed V funnel, pinched collar, neck rolls, floating collar, clipping, or cream belly bib. Preserve the actual open or closed garment state and fastening, ensuring coherent front and rear collar overlap with contact shadows. Retain the complete tilted dark frame, opaque photographic backing in its actual primary color, and the attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. All solid surfaces must remain opaque, with alpha transparency only outside the complete card silhouette. Keep fine primary details understated and indistinct where they are not clearly visible in the source. Do not add spectacles, ties, chin beards, or caps. Preserve the actual primary mild angle, head roll, grey lighting, and close crop from the source image.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: BAREHEADED short GREY/BROWN side-parted hair with brushed-up top and real dark/grey eyebrow HAIR, actual narrow DARK upper-lip MOUSTACHE, smooth clean chin and serious CLOSED mouth. OLIVE/BROWN CLOSED military tunic with RED upright collar and clearly source-visible GOLD STAR-shaped collar emblems, RED/GOLD shoulder edge and only note-limited exposed small chest fittings. No cap, spectacles, tie or chin beard. Preserve actual primary mild angle/head roll, grey light and close crop, do not invent hidden full medal rows.
Retain exact primary head angle, expression, cap shape, real hair and visible clothing/decoration areas. One compact near-round yellow mascot head with a clearly ROUNDED short chin immediately contacting raised broad collar, no V-shaped lower-face funnel or yellow shaft. Preserve actual dark solid cloth and photographic backing opacity. Tiny ambiguous features remain understated; no new badge engraving or decorations hidden behind note. Image1 exact original card; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
